load_data2vec2_model: load a Data2Vec2 vision model by name such as data2vec2_vitb16 onto a device
create_d2v2_model: create a Data2Vec2 VisionTransformer model from a timm model name like vit_base_patch16_224
convert_data2vec2_state_dict: convert a Data2Vec2 state dict to timm-compatible key names for loading
run_patched_forward: run the patched forward pass on an image tensor to get cls token and patch embeddings
review_WeirdD2V2Block: review the WeirdD2V2Block class which implements a pre-norm residual transformer block
